account:
Today I have kept my market walk, lunch at home, and office accounts appointments. The treasury held 128 emeralds, which I left untouched. My next appointment is tea at 15:00 at an east-bank dockside cottage, but I still do not know which neighbour or cottage. The secretary secured a copy of my schedule and agreed to investigate the builder and Freight and identify the tea host; she is now approaching, so I should ask for her report.

The unusual business is the builder's repeated attempts to speak with Freight. At about 09:48 I heard the builder shout, “Freight, please wait! I need a private word.” I heard other shouting without understanding it, and around 12:48 heard the builder again without making out the words. I do not know what their discussion concerns. Townsfolk reported the baker carrying wheat at the bakery earlier, then bread at the inn around 13:57. Freight is now near the town hall carrying a sack of bread and holding an emerald. This could be ordinary bread purchasing or deliveries; I have no evidence that it is improper or connected to the builder's request. I also noticed a block in the town hall change from air to oak planks at 13:17, but did not see who placed it or learn why. These matters deserve clarification rather than assumptions.
